subject: gk
question: Which of the following is correct regarding Personal Disposable Income?

options.text: Personal Disposable Income ≡ Personal Income + Personal tax payments - Non-tax payments
Personal Disposable Income ≡ Personal Income – Personal tax payments - Non-tax payments
Personal Disposable Income ≡ Personal Income – Personal tax payments + Non-tax payments
Personal Disposable Income ≡ Personal Income + Personal tax payments + Non-tax payments

solution:
The correct answer is __**Personal Disposable Income ≡ Personal Income – Personal tax payments - Non-tax payments**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Personal disposable income(DPI):

__
 
• It is the amount of money that an individual or household has to spend or save after income taxes have been deducted.
 
• It is also known as disposable income.
 
• At the macro level, disposable personal income is closely monitored as one of the key economic indicators used to gauge the overall state of the economy.
 
• Formula:
 
 
• Personal disposable income = personal income – personal tax payment – non-tax payment 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Significance:

 
 
• Disposable income is the portion of income available to an income earner after all income taxes are deducted.
 
• It is used by analysts to measure consumer spending, payment ability, probable future savings, and the overall health of a nation’s economy.
 
• Disposable income can be used to determine the financial reserves of households and the money available to be spent on goods and services.
